notes: The document catalogue (Unit DE, Queue 16). Every entry is sourced — a document exists in this catalogue only because a merged source already names it as a thing a character holds. Prices live only in data/prices.json 'documents' via price_ref and are 0 for every entry: a document's value is the right it records, not a sale price, and no source prices a replacement — the replacement fee (if any) is a Phase 6 decision, not set here, so 0 means UNPRICED, not free. The college credential is programme-specific in the sim (certifications.programme carries engineering/medicine/teaching/programming); the catalogue id is the kind, and the programme rides in the certifications row, not here. A certification record (academics.py) is NOT an inventory row — the seeding unit decides how a certificate becomes a losable document row, and until then these catalogue ids seed nothing. No seeding yet.
